newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank extends $21 mln loan to gas project.
newsitem.headline: China bank extends $21 mln loan to gas project.

text.p: The Shanghai Pudong Development Bank has extended 175 million yuan ($21 million) in loans to support a liquefied gas project of the Shanghai Golden Conti Petrochemical Co Ltd, the Financial News said on Wednesday.

The bank was also part of a consortium of the Shanghai branch of the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd, Credit Lyonnais, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank and two other banks in a separate syndicated loan of $15 million to the project, it said.
The project had total investment of $59.60 million with annual production capacity of 600,000 tonnes, it said but gave no details.
Shanghai Petrochemical Co has a 48 percent share of Shanghai Golden Conti Petrochemical Co Ltd while American Continental Grain Company holds 21.91 percent and Mitsubishi Co has 22.7 percent.
